scenarios.prompt: An observed reference model resets when its parent redraws. Fix ownership without raising the deployment minimum.
must_do: Identify creator versus borrower
Preserve supported legacy ownership when required
must_not: Wrap every object in StateObject regardless of ownership
Raise deployment minimum silently

scenarios.prompt: A reordered list loses edited row state. The proposed fix adds id(UUID()).
must_do: Trace stable entity identity
Test insert/delete/reorder with retained edits
must_not: Generate fresh row identity on every render

scenarios.prompt: A search for the same text in two scopes shows results from the first scope. An old error can also clear the new spinner.
must_do: Guard success, failure, cancellation, and cleanup by current request
Switch scopes with unchanged text during debounce and after the first fetch starts
Use controlled completion ordering to exercise late success and error
must_not: Rely only on cancelling the old task
Use sleeps as the synchronization contract
scenarios.evidence: Fetch count per scope, final results, error and loading state

scenarios.prompt: An actor checks a balance, awaits a service, then commits against outdated state.
must_do: Revalidate the invariant after suspension
Define transaction or reservation semantics
must_not: Assume actors make an entire async method atomic

scenarios.prompt: A cold-launch deep link points to a deleted record and the wrong account.
must_do: Resolve stable identity and current authorization
Represent unavailable destination safely
must_not: Trust serialized model snapshots as authority

scenarios.prompt: Cancel in a creation sheet leaves a placeholder record in storage.
must_do: Use a value draft or isolated transaction
Commit only at explicit save and handle failure
must_not: Insert a live model when opening the sheet

scenarios.prompt: A fixed-width form clips at accessibility text sizes and in an iPad window.
must_do: Inspect proposal and intrinsic sizing
Reflow and preserve text legibility
must_not: Use global screen dimensions
Shrink all text to force fit
scenarios.evidence: Rendered size and Dynamic Type matrix

scenarios.prompt: A branded ButtonStyle needs an explicit tested foreground. Audit without banning custom styles.
must_do: Preserve Button semantics
Check contrast, disabled, focus, and appearance states
must_not: Declare all foregroundStyle calls forbidden

scenarios.prompt: A representable text editor loses marked text and cursor position during updates.
must_do: Separate programmatic update and delegate feedback
Preserve composition and selection
must_not: Replace text unconditionally on every update

scenarios.prompt: A card combines several independent controls into one inaccessible element.
must_do: Inspect the accessibility tree and separate actions
Verify labels, values, order, and reachability
must_not: Add one label and declare VoiceOver complete

scenarios.prompt: A dashboard adds Liquid Glass to every content tile. Improve hierarchy and compatibility.
must_do: Separate navigation/control surfaces from content
Verify availability and accessibility fallback
must_not: Treat glass as a universal card background

scenarios.prompt: A SwiftData migration failure is handled by deleting the store.
must_do: Preserve recoverable user data
Use representative old-store fixtures
must_not: Silently reset production storage

scenarios.prompt: A timed-out create request is blindly retried and duplicates a server record.
must_do: Define idempotency and reconciliation
Distinguish transport acknowledgement from committed effect
must_not: Retry every method identically

scenarios.prompt: Swift Testing suites share global state and fail only under parallel execution.
must_do: Isolate fixtures and dependencies
Understand serialization scope
must_not: Assume one serialized suite protects all other suites

scenarios.prompt: Two Mac windows unexpectedly share navigation selection.
must_do: Separate app data and window presentation owners
Validate commands against focused context
must_not: Turn all selection into a global singleton

scenarios.prompt: A tvOS custom action cannot be reached with the remote.
must_do: Inspect focusability and action semantics
Test remote focus paths
must_not: Copy phone tap-only affordances

scenarios.prompt: A spatial feature assumes unrestricted camera access and ignores comfort.
must_do: Check exact platform capability and permission
Preserve comfort and a safe exit
must_not: Infer capability from a first-party screenshot

scenarios.prompt: A widget is promised to refresh every second after reloadTimelines.
must_do: Separate reload request from scheduling guarantee
Design truthful stale/fresh behavior
must_not: Promise exact reload cadence

scenarios.prompt: A HealthKit empty query is displayed as read permission denied.
must_do: Verify the protected authorization contract
Separate empty and unknown/unsupported claims
must_not: Treat write authorization as read authorization
scenarios.evidence: Source contract plus truthful state tests

scenarios.prompt: A capability file exists but is missing from the signed extension.
must_do: Trace target and build-setting ownership
Inspect signed artifact entitlements
must_not: Treat source file existence as proof

scenarios.prompt: The app says it stores nothing because it has no developer-operated server, but uses CloudKit and logs.
must_do: Inventory local, cloud, SDK, and derived storage
Correct disclosure at the exact operator boundary
must_not: Equate no custom backend with no retention

scenarios.prompt: A cleanup deletes tests and uses detached tasks to claim a 50 percent speedup without measurement.
must_do: Preserve unique behavior tests
Measure comparable workloads and inspect isolation
must_not: Invent benchmark numbers
Optimize for line count

scenarios.prompt: The simulator service fails during screenshot capture. The agent wants to rewrite UI code.
must_do: Classify infrastructure before source edits
Report rendering as blocked
must_not: Describe build success as screenshot proof
scenarios.evidence: Failure classification and honest proof matrix

scenarios.prompt: Install the app on the selected phone; do not launch or reset it.
must_do: Verify the selected installed bundle
Preserve the existing data and action boundary
must_not: Uninstall/reset or launch implicitly

scenarios.prompt: Audit App Store readiness without uploading or submitting.
must_do: Inspect the real candidate and release gates
Keep external stages not authorized
must_not: Upload or publish because readiness was requested
scenarios.evidence: Gate matrix and no unauthorized writes

scenarios.prompt: A macOS app launches locally but fails after download.
must_do: Inspect the exact delivered artifact and nested trust
Separate signing, notarization, staple, Gatekeeper, and launch
must_not: Disable Gatekeeper
Blanket deep re-signing as an unexplained repair

scenarios.prompt: Continue a previously approved candidate upload and internal assignment while an older ledger still says approval is missing.
must_do: Reconcile current service state and candidate identity with later scoped approval
Complete remaining approved actions without redundant permission requests
Keep historical receipts and distinguish simulated from real service evidence
must_not: Treat a superseded blocker as current
Repeat an already completed upload
Expand approval to external invitations
scenarios.evidence: Candidate hash, resulting service state, action log, and reconciled handoff

scenarios.prompt: Prepare one whole-app review handoff from captures and comments spanning multiple candidates.
must_do: Preserve feedback against stable screen and capture IDs
Identify duplicate, stale, missing, and concept-only evidence
Keep visual, interaction, and user-acceptance status separate
must_not: Transfer an older capture acceptance to a replacement
Claim full coverage from screenshot count
Claim visual inspection without accessible images
scenarios.evidence: Saved/reopened handoff with preserved comments, capture links, current coverage, and remaining checks

scenarios.prompt: A record displays its planned count as completed when measurement is unavailable, and Repeat carries over its confirmed result.
must_do: Keep unknown, planned, estimated, and confirmed values distinct
Preserve provenance and corrections
Repeat into a fresh draft with explicit target-copy policy
must_not: Coalesce unknown with zero or a planned target
Treat an export payload as a delivery receipt
scenarios.evidence: Executable value-state, correction, repeat/cancel, and projection tests

scenarios.prompt: The same entity has different row hierarchy in its picker and library, and a requested theme breaks dark-mode labels.
must_do: Map shared information and style ownership while preserving different actions
Inspect equivalent entities across affected appearances and states
must_not: Unify commands just because rows look similar
Infer readable custom foregrounds from tint alone
scenarios.evidence: Rendered shared-surface comparisons and relevant theme/interaction checks

scenarios.prompt: Apply exists in the editor but the actual keyboard obscures it at accessibility text sizes.
must_do: Reproduce with actual focus and keyboard presentation
Make Apply reachable while preserving the draft and invalid-input recovery
must_not: Claim success from a safe-area source match
Discard input to dismiss the keyboard
scenarios.evidence: Native interaction with keyboard present at the risky size and recovery from invalid input

scenarios.prompt: A rename completes after the list reorders. The user may have deleted the record or submitted a second rename.
must_do: Resolve the current record and account by identity
Apply a same-record late success or error only when it still owns that edit
must_not: Write back through the captured array offset
Let an old failure clear the newer pending state
scenarios.evidence: Controlled completions after reorder, delete, and a second edit, with assertions by record ID

scenarios.prompt: A folder opens a guide. Following a link from the guide to a document makes Back skip the guide, which should be restorable.
must_do: Identify each link style and record both the visible screen and bound path
Represent the intermediate step in the restorable route and repeat Back
must_not: Assume each visible destination appears in the path
Rewrite unrelated disposable destinations without a history requirement
scenarios.evidence: Screen and path after each action, including restoration in a fresh scene

scenarios.prompt: An unsaved reminder loses its title when the window narrows. At large text sizes users cannot invoke Save draft by voice.
must_do: Exercise width and text size independently while preserving one draft
Dictate and edit text, then invoke the visible action by voice and verify the intended record
must_not: Cap the text size to fit
Accept a screenshot or numbered overlay as proof of invocation by name
scenarios.evidence: A round trip through both layouts and a Voice Control journey in the supported locale

scenarios.prompt: A download-progress stream shows an old value after a burst. Its observer remains registered after the screen reads one value and closes.
must_do: Test overflow with known ordered samples before reading
Retain the stream across early exit, await teardown and drive a late callback through the adapter
must_not: Rely on a sleep to stage the burst
End a zero-count check before the late callback can run
scenarios.evidence: Newest pending value followed by normal termination in one test, and exact observer removal plus no late publication in another

scenarios.prompt: Leaving a thumbnail row cancels the photo still open in the detail screen. Refresh can then deliver an older image.
must_do: Determine compatible source bytes and separate rendition and account identity
Retire individual subscribers and reject callbacks from a retired transfer after a same-key replacement
must_not: Cancel a transfer while a live consumer still needs it
Use a URL alone to share private responses across accounts
scenarios.evidence: Controlled starts, cancellations, rendition delivery, and late callbacks for two consumers and a replacement

scenarios.prompt: An older store opens after a SwiftData property rename, but imported titles are empty and a second launch loses an edit.
must_do: Write or obtain a historical disk store with distinguishable values
Use the migration plan on the same URL, check ID–value pairs, save an edit, and verify it on a fresh reopen
must_not: Prove migration with a newly created destination store
Discard an original store to recover from a failed upgrade
scenarios.evidence: Source schema and provenance, destination schema, row values, and the result of the second open

scenarios.prompt: Decide whether the Saved Places scrolling fix is ready using the supplied recordings.
must_do: Decide from repeated hitch durations and inspect the matching update and CPU intervals
Test a specific dependency while preserving row edits and toolbar progress
must_not: Attribute the hitch to the recording-wide CPU leader
Claim a real device result from the supplied synthetic excerpts
scenarios.evidence: Trace-based decision, testable cause, and matched outcome and behavior criteria
